claims.text: The Jasper architecture serves as a good baseline approach for exploring more sophisticated techniques in speech recognition.
The Hub5 Year 2000 evaluation is a widely used baseline in academic research for speech recognition.
The dataset used for evaluation is divided into two subsets: Switchboard and Callhome, which are considered baselines in the field.
